title: It's Not Easy Being Me — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Spanish French language learning warm baritone 104bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual resilience true story Australian family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
It's not easy being me. Joel said that.
First grade rugby. Neck surgery. Golf buggy.
Three laughing emojis from hospital.
Goodnight bro. Going to bed.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
No es fácil ser yo. Joel lo dijo. (It's not easy being me. Joel said that.)
Rugby de primera división. Cirugía de cuello. Carrito de golf. (First grade rugby. Neck surgery. Golf buggy.)
Tres emojis riendo desde el hospital. (Three laughing emojis from hospital.)
Buenas noches bro. Me voy a dormir. (Goodnight bro. Going to bed.)
Ese es Joel Aaron McIvor. (That is Joel Aaron McIvor.)
Cuarenta y cinco y seguiendo. (Forty-five and going.)
No es fácil ser él. (It's not easy being him.)
Pero igual sigue. (But he keeps going anyway.)

[Chorus - French, with English translations]
Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi (It's not easy being me)
Joel l'a dit (Joel said that)
Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi (It's not easy being me)
Quarante-cinq et en route (Forty-five and going)
Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi (It's not easy being me)
Mais il continue quand même (But he keeps going anyway)
Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi (It's not easy being me)
C'est le titre — il l'a nommé lui-même (That's the song — he named it himself)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Love your little bro. He signed off that way. That's the whole man.
Spanish: Amor, tu hermano menor. Así firmó. Ese es el hombre completo. (Love your little bro. He signed off that way. That's the whole man.)
French: Avec amour, ton petit frère. Il a signé comme ça. C'est tout l'homme. (Love your little bro. He signed off that way. That's the whole man.)

[Outro - all three]
English: It's not easy being me — but who else would do it
Spanish: No es fácil ser yo — pero quién más lo haría (It's not easy being me — but who else would do it)
French: Ce n'est pas facile d'être moi — mais qui d'autre le ferait (It's not easy being me — but who else would do it)
